claim: Works offline after the first visit
sandbox: fresh browser context; visit /demo, wait for the cached shell, go offline, navigate to edit and back

claim: Demo item data stays in this browser
where: landing facts, privacy page, and README
sandbox: fresh /demo context; intercept a full edit and save flow; assert every request is same-origin
fresh context with no license; save a manual item and find it in /records

claim: Shows saved cards with the same barcode for review
sandbox: fresh /demo context; enter an existing sample barcode; assert the candidate and review link

claim: A chosen supplier CSV can fill matching item fields
sandbox: fresh context; upload an in-memory supplier CSV and match one barcode

claim: Exports every saved card as CSV
sandbox: fresh /demo context; download CSV; assert header and one row per sample card

claim: Searches saved cards by barcode, item, supplier, or location
sandbox: fresh /demo context; search a location; assert only its matching card remains

claim: Exports and imports a complete JSON backup
sandbox: fresh real-data context; save one card, export it, delete it, import the backup, and assert it returns

claim: Creates a printable one-up card with a barcode
sandbox: fresh /demo context; open the first print card; assert barcode marks and location

claim: Demo data never touches real cards
sandbox: fresh context; seed /demo then open /records and assert the sample cards are absent

claim: The licensed scan action opens the device camera
sandbox: fresh /demo context with a fake permitted camera; assert the camera is absent before the action and ready after it

claim: A pasted license is verified by the Sociobot billing API
sandbox: fresh context; mock the documented verify response; paste a token; assert the active state
